request.description:
Info pembayaran: total, metode tersedia, sisa TTL, snap token.

Logika enabled per metode:
- remainingSeconds < estSeconds -> enabled: false
- Booking EXPIRED -> semua disabled + backDisabled: true

Estimasi waktu metode:
- qris / gopay: 30s
- bca_va: 180s

Response contoh:
{
  "bookingId": "uuid",
  "total": 500000,
  "remainingSeconds": 540,
  "status": "HELD",
  "backDisabled": false,
  "snapToken": "",
  "methods": [
    { "code": "qris",   "name": "QRIS",                "estSeconds": 30,  "enabled": true },
    { "code": "gopay",  "name": "GoPay",               "estSeconds": 30,  "enabled": true },
    { "code": "bca_va", "name": "BCA Virtual Account",  "estSeconds": 180, "enabled": true }
  ]
}

Mulai pembayaran via Midtrans Snap.

Idempotency: jika booking sudah punya payment PENDING, return yang lama (Midtrans tidak di-charge ulang).

Method validation (server-side, bukan percaya klien):
- remainingSeconds < estSeconds -> 409 METHOD_TIME_INSUFFICIENT
- Booking status != HELD -> 410 BOOKING_EXPIRED

Method valid: qris | gopay | bca_va

Response contoh:
{
  "paymentId": "uuid",
  "status": "PENDING",
  "snapToken": "abc123",
  "redirectUrl": "https://app.sandbox.midtrans.com/snap/v2/vtweb/abc123",
  "method": "qris"
}

Webhook dari Midtrans. TIDAK butuh auth — diverifikasi via signature_key.

Signature: SHA512(order_id + status_code + gross_amount + MIDTRANS_SERVER_KEY)

Generate di terminal:
echo -n 'ORDER_ID200500000.00SERVER_KEY' | sha512sum

Idempotency: INSERT ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING — 2x callback aman.

Status yang di-handle:
- settlement / capture + fraud_status=accept -> booking PAID
- expire / cancel / deny -> booking EXPIRED

Gross amount validation: nominal di callback harus cocok dengan total di DB.
